rationale: Power intent is per-implementation, not protocol-level

power_domains_summary.HBA_core: Digital supply for AHCI register block + DMA engine.
power_domains_summary.PHY_analog: Analog supply for SATA PHY macro per port.
power_domains_summary.PHY_VDDIO: IO ring supply for SATA differential pair termination.
power_domains_summary.DEVSLP_IO: Sideband IO supply for DEVSLP driver (AHCI 1.3.1).

host_pci_power_states.name: D3HOT
host_pci_power_states.description: Configuration accessible; memory not. D1/D2 NOT supported.

power_up_sequence: 3. PCI enumeration; software sets CMD.MSE + CMD.BME.
5. Per-port: program PxCLB / PxFB; set PxCMD.FRE=1; PxCMD.SUD=1 if CAP.SSS=1; PxCMD.ST=1.
6. PHY: OOB → speed negotiation → L0; device sends signature D2H Register FIS.
7. Software issues commands via PxCI / PxSACT.

low_power_modes_summary.Clock_gating: Internal HBA clock-gating when PxCMD.ST=0 + PxCI=0.
low_power_modes_summary.HBA_D3: D3HOT; register memory inaccessible until D0.

devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DITO: Software-programmed idle timeout (ms) before DEVSLP auto-assertion (ADSE mode).
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DM: DITO multiplier — extends max DITO to 16 × 16368 ms.
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_MDAT: Minimum assertion time (nominal 10 ms, min 1 ms).
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DETO: Maximum exit timeout from DEVSLP de-assertion to device-ready (nominal 20 ms, max 255 ms).
devsleep_power_envelope.PxDEVSLP_DSP: Set by platform when the device + connector + host support DEVSLP.
devsleep_power_envelope.CAP2_DESO: When 1, HBA may only assert DEVSLP from Slumber state (PxSSTS.IPM=6h).

fields.notes: SAS's protocol-level power intent is the phy power conditions (partial / slumber) and staggered spin-up (NOTIFY ENABLE SPINUP) rather than a fine-grained power-domain spec. Detailed rails and low-power SerDes behavior are physical-layer / implementation concerns.

power_management_states.name: Active
power_management_states.description: Phy synchronized; connections may be open and frames flowing.

power_management_states.name: Partial
power_management_states.description: Phy power condition with reduced power and fast wake.

power_management_states.name: Slumber
power_management_states.description: Deeper phy power condition with longer wake latency.

fields.wakeup_mechanism: Phy power management (partial / slumber) is entered and exited via NOTIFY (ENABLE SPINUP) and the phy power-management primitives; the phy can reduce power while remaining able to wake on activity (COMWAKE / OOB).

power_rails.purpose: Supplied through the SAS connector (with ENABLE SPINUP staggered spin-up).

fields.sas_power_considerations: SAS defines phy power conditions (active / partial / slumber) and staggered spin-up of drives via NOTIFY (ENABLE SPINUP) to bound inrush current; most energy management is a SerDes / device concern, while the protocol contributes the phy power-management primitives.
